name: @zipy/export
description: Zipy AI export renderers: PDF, HTML, Markdown (phase 20 batch 0). DOCX, image-pack and embed renderers land in batch 1; layout templates and the export route in batch 2.
workspaces_dependencies_notes: This package depends only on pdf-lib at runtime. DOCX export (batch 1) will add the docx writer, but the choice of library is deferred to that batch so no unused dependency is declared here. Image-pack export (batch 1) will use the platform's zip utility or the archiver package, again deferred.
